description: Looking for tummy tuck in Malaysia? Dr. Soma offers comprehensive abdominoplasty to restore a flatter, firmer abdomen with surgical precision and structured postoperative care.

acceptedAnswer.text: A tummy tuck is a surgical procedure that removes excess abdominal skin and fat while tightening weakened abdominal muscles to create a flatter abdomen.

mainEntity.name: Is a tummy tuck the same as liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Liposuction removes fat only, while a tummy tuck also removes loose skin and tightens muscles.
When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a regulated facility, it is considered a safe and well-established procedure.
Most patients return to daily activities within 2-4 weeks, with final results visible over 3-6 months.

Results are long-lasting if body weight remains stable.

mainEntity.name: Can pregnancy affect tummy tuck results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pregnancy can stretch the abdomen again, so surgery is best after completing childbearing.

mainEntity.name: Who should consider a tummy tuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patients with loose abdominal skin, muscle laxity, stable weight, and realistic expectations.

mainEntity.name: Can a tummy tuck improve posture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Muscle repair can enhance core support and posture.

mainEntity.name: Can it be combined with other procedures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is commonly combined with liposuction for enhanced contouring.
